title: Marketing and Communications
description:
Marketing and Communications: Location: Tunbridge Wells

Office based Monday to Friday 9-5

Salary: £35,000-£40,000 per annum - dependant on experience

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Are you a creative and proactive with 3 years plus experience in marketing, managing your role? Looking to develop your career within a fast-paced events environment?

We are looking for someone to:
- drive the marketing function
- experience essential
- new ideas and new approaches
- taking greater ownership of strategy and performance
- developing the team
- helping us improve how we market and grow our events.

Personable, professional with high level communication skills- working alongside 3 directors and external business relations.

We're recruiting for an established international events business operating across the health, personal care and pharmaceutical sectors. This is a fantastic opportunity to take ownership of marketing and communications activity for a portfolio of UK-based conferences and exhibitions.

Working closely with the Communications Manager, you'll help deliver multi-channel marketing campaigns designed to increase brand awareness, generate leads and engage key audiences.

The Role

You will be involved across the full marketing mix, combining content creation, email marketing, social media, digital campaigns and event promotion.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Delivering marketing campaigns across email, social media, direct mail and web.
- Creating engaging and persuasive content for digital channels, websites and printed materials.
- Managing and executing email marketing campaigns and reporting on performance.
- Creating high-quality marketing collateral using Canva or similar design tools.
- Supporting the sales team with effective marketing materials.
- Maintaining communications plans and marketing calendars for individual events.
- Supporting market research, data analysis and reporting.
- Bringing fresh ideas to increase audience engagement and brand awareness.
- Attending events as part of the on-site team and capturing content for future campaigns.

About You

We're looking for someone who is curious, organised and keen to develop. You'll enjoy taking ownership of your work while collaborating effectively with colleagues.

You'll ideally have:
- At least 3 year's plus experience within a marketing role, ideally within events, B2 B marketing or a similar environment.
- Leading and able to demonstrate independent work within your marketing career to date.
- Experience delivering marketing campaigns and communications plans.
- Hands-on email marketing experience, including campaign creation and reporting.
- Experience creating digital marketing assets using Canva or similar.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Confidence managing social media accounts and producing engaging content, including video.
- Experience using AI tools for ideas and drafting while maintaining brand voice and quality.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
- Competent Microsoft Excel skills.

Experience or knowledge of digital marketing and/or a Marketing-related degree would be advantageous but is not essential.

Why Apply? This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious marketer who wants more than simply ticking off tasks. You'll have the chance to test ideas, develop your skills and see the direct impact of your marketing activity while building your career within the events sector.

Salary: £35,000-£40,000 per annum

Location: Tunbridge Wells Office Based

Full-time Permanent

In application for this role, you are consenting to TN Recruits Ltd retaining your details to secure you work. All information provided will be held securely for up to 3 years unless we are contacted and instructed otherwise.

title: Retail Social Media Manager
description:
I am recruiting for a Social Media Manager on behalf of a premium consumer retail business that is looking to elevate its social media presence and build highly engaged communities across multiple brands.

This opportunity would suit someone from a retail, ecommerce, or consumer brand background who understands how social media can drive both brand awareness and commercial performance. You'll be confident creating content and comfortable being in front of the camera, whether that's presenting products, interviewing guests, or developing engaging social-first video content.

A key focus of the role will be the exciting opportunity to launch and grow the company's TikTok presence, developing a platform strategy from the ground up and creating content that resonates with new and existing audiences.

Working closely with the wider marketing team, you'll own the organic social strategy, manage creator partnerships, and use insights and performance data to continually improve results.

Key Responsibilities

Own and deliver the social media strategy across consumer, trade, and brand channels.

Create engaging content for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.

Appear on camera and develop social-first video content.

Launch and grow the company's TikTok channel and community.

Manage influencer and creator partnerships.

Build engaged online communities through proactive community management.

Track performance, report on key metrics, and identify growth opportunities.

Collaborate with marketing, ecommerce, and commercial teams to support wider business objectives.

What we need from you:

Proven experience managing organic social media channels for a consumer-facing brand.

Demonstrable success growing engaged audiences and communities.

Experience working within a direct-to-consumer ecommerce business, premium retailer, or consumer brand.

Strong content creation skills, particularly across short-form video and social-first content.

Strong understanding of social media analytics and reporting tools.

Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Knowledge of social media management platforms such as Sprout Social.

Experience using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar design tools.

Experience managing multiple brands with distinct audiences and brand voices

This is a hybrid position with 2 days in the office so you must be able to drive to Tonbridge for the 2 roles. If you are interested in the role then please apply ASAP!

title: Senior SEO Manager
description:
Are you an experienced SEO professional who enjoys having real ownership of strategy, working directly with clients and seeing your recommendations turn into commercial results?

We're looking for a Senior SEO Manager to join a growing, close-knit digital team and take the lead on SEO strategy across a varied portfolio of established eCommerce, B2 B and professional services clients.

This is a hands-on senior role where you'll have the freedom to shape strategy, influence clients and work closely with developers, account managers and growth specialists to make things happen.

What you'll be doing

You'll take full ownership of your SEO accounts, from identifying opportunities and building strategic roadmaps through to implementation, reporting and client presentations.

Your role will include:
- Developing and leading SEO strategies aligned to clients' commercial objectives
- Managing senior client relationships and leading regular SEO meetings
- Identifying opportunities across technical, on-page and content SEO
- Carrying out keyword, competitor and search landscape research
- Working directly with developers to prioritise and implement technical improvements
- Analysing performance and delivering commercially focused reporting
- Advising on SEO for website builds, migrations and launches
- Supporting pitches and new business opportunities as the SEO specialist
- Working with Account Managers to identify growth opportunities within existing accounts
- Keeping ahead of changes in search, including AI search and emerging platforms

What we're looking for

You'll have at least five years' SEO experience, ideally in an agency or similar environment where you've managed multiple clients and taken ownership of both strategy and relationships.

You'll bring:
- Strong experience developing and leading SEO strategies
- Proven experience managing senior client relationships
- Excellent technical, on-page and content SEO knowledge
- Experience managing SEO for eCommerce websites
- Confidence presenting strategy, recommendations and results to clients
- Strong knowledge of GA4, Google Search Console and leading SEO tools
- A good understanding of website development and experience working with developers
- Experience with website migrations and new website launches
- Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how SEO drives leads, sales and revenue
- The confidence to challenge existing approaches and recommend a better way forward
- A genuine interest in AI search and the changing search landscape

Experience with Magento/Adobe Commerce, WordPress or App Store Optimisation would be an advantage.

Why join?

You'll be joining a small, collaborative team where your ideas genuinely matter. You'll work closely with senior leadership and have visibility across the wider business, rather than being another cog in a large agency machine.

You'll work with a diverse mix of ambitious start-ups and established eCommerce brands across different industries and technologies, meaning no two projects are the same.

There's also a strong focus on development, with access to training and regular collaboration with an international development team.

And when the team hits its monthly and annual targets, there are socials and trips away to celebrate together.
